text.en:
1. This Act may be cited as the Degrees and Diplomas Act,
1962, and shall be deemed to |have come into force on the
first day of January, 1962.

2. (1) Where the possession of any degree or diploma of
the former University of Malaya confers any qualification
or right under any written law passed or made before the
year 1962, the like qualification or right under that law
shall be conferred by poss¢ssion of the corresponding
degree or diploma of the present University of Malaya or
of the University of Singapore.

(2) In this Act "the former (University of Malaya" means
the University established and incorporated under the
University of Malaya Ordinance, 1949, and "the present
University of Malaya" means the University of Malaya
established and incorporated under the University of
Malaya Act, 1961.

[Received the Royal Assent
on the 16th day of
July, 1962.
